Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner abruptly pivoted from the correct, well-supported identification of the Ogallala (High Plains) Aquifer to claiming the “North Platte River alluvial aquifer” without authoritative evidence, misinterpreting local confinement context and contradicting cited sources. This unsupported assumption led to an incorrect final answer despite prior results indicating the Ogallala Aquifer is the shallow water-table aquifer near Ogallala (the county seat).
